entities.name: Query protein Rpo1N
observations: 768 aa protein; predicted molecular mass 85.9 kDa, pI 9.08, and net charge +21.95 at pH 7.
Pfam domains RNA_pol_Rpb1_1 (PF04997; residues 11–365), RNA_pol_Rpb1_2 (PF00623; residues 367–534), and RNA_pol_Rpb1_3 (PF04983; residues 537–713) span most of the sequence.
Best reviewed homologs are archaeal DNA-directed RNA polymerase subunit Rpo1N proteins with 37.2–37.8% identity, 98.7% query coverage, and E-values of 6e-153 to 8e-154.
Homolog annotations identify Rpo1N as the clamp-head subunit of multisubunit DNA-dependent RNA polymerase, associated with DNA-templated transcription and RNA polymerase complex assembly.

Homolog annotations report cytoplasmic localization and binding of Mg2+ plus multiple structural Zn2+ ions; these cofactor assignments are transferred from homologs and are not direct experiments on this sequence.

The inferred RNA polymerase reaction is RNA(n) plus ribonucleoside 5'-triphosphate yielding RNA(n+1) plus diphosphate; the catalytic activity belongs to the assembled RNAP complex rather than necessarily this subunit alone.
